subject: Re: Discovery call — model fit & next steps / model regression
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme.com>, Alex Lim <alex.lim@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — model fit & next steps

Jamie / Alex,

Thanks again for taking the call today — really appreciate the clear context on the summary use cases and the high-sensitivity UX paths you highlighted. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Summary: primary need is a condensed product-summary + compliance highlight for returns workflows (short, highly factual).
- Initial model fit: based on the examples you shared, we recommend starting with model: redwood-open-7B-v1.3 (quantized) for latency/cost tradeoffs and redwood-legal-13B-v2 for higher-fidelity compliance responses where precision matters.
- Evals: I've uploaded a short prompt set (acme_prompt_set_v1.json) and an initial eval report to the Drive link below. The eval shows redwood-open-7B-v1.3 hitting your P95 latency target with acceptable ROUGE/precision for the less-critical paths; legal-13B gives better factuality on compliance prompts.

Next concrete steps:
1) We'll run a 1-week A/B on a subset of traffic: v1.3 (control) vs v1.4 (new) — goal is to measure regression risk on the compliance prompts.
2) I'll drop the prompt set and eval link in this thread (attached) and introduce you to our infra lead for rollout/rollback details.
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up next Wednesday to review early metrics and make a pin/rollback decision.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-evals

If you want us to pin to v1.3 immediately instead of rolling v1.4 into your test, say the word and we'll lock the model.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: acme_prompt_set_v1.json (prompt set, 42 items)

From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Lim <alex.lim@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — model fit & next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the prompt set. We started a small smoke test overnight and noticed some quality regressions versus the baseline. Two quick examples included inlined below (redacted):

- Prompt A (returns policy): v1.4 produced a shorter summary that omitted the exception clause we require.
- Prompt B (taxable items): v1.4 hallucinated a tax rule that doesn't apply to our region.

I'm attaching the snippets in a separate doc. This is concerning for our compliance UX flows — can you confirm which exact model version is live for our environment? We'd prefer to pin to the last-known-good if v1.4 is causing regressions.

Also looping in any engineering contacts who can advise on quick rollback options. We have a go/no-go Friday decision for the pilot.

—Jamie
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Retail
jamie.torres@acme.com

On Fri, 13 Mar 2026 at 06:45, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Received — thanks for the examples. We'll prioritize this.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme.com>, Alex Lim <alex.lim@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — model fit & next steps / model regression

Jamie —

Really appreciate the prompt examples and the clear failure modes. Quick operational proposal from Redwood: 

- Immediate action: We'll pin your environment to redwood-open-7B-v1.3 (sha: a9f3d2) as the known-good baseline while we triage the v1.4 diffs. Pinning is reversible and should be transparent to your app.
- Triage plan: our infra & eval teams will run a differential eval between v1.4 and v1.3 on your prompt set (we'll annotate per-example deltas). Expect an initial diff report by EOD today (attached: redwood_evals_report_20260314.pdf and a compact patch of operator-visible diffs model_diff_v1.4_vs_v1.3.patch).
- Rollback vs pin: Pinning (recommended) freezes the model mapping for your account. Full rollback (on shared infra) will revert any routed traffic back to v1.3 globally for your tenancy; we recommend pin + scoped rollback only if diffs are significant for production.

Operational notes:
- Impact window: pin takes effect within 2–5 minutes; global rollback requires a rolling restart and is typically complete within 20–40 minutes during a maintenance window.
- Data: no training data will be used — this is inference-side versioning only.
- Approvals: we can proceed on your sign-off; otherwise we'll schedule a 30-min call with your engineering lead to walk the diffs.

I've attached the prompt set and will post the eval link when ready. If you'd like, we can also enable a small Canary route (5% traffic) to v1.4 with per-example logging so we can capture regressions without exposing the full pilot.

Next steps (please confirm):
1) Approve immediate pin to v1.3 for Acme test tenancy.
2) Approve 5% Canary to v1.4 with logging OR full pin until triage completes.
3) 30-min triage call today at 4pm PT (I can host).

—Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery call — model fit & next steps / model regression

Marissa / team —

Quick technical notes and plan for the rollback/pin: 

- Confirmed: Acme's test tenancy currently routing to redwood-open-7B-v1.4 (release tag: r1.4-2026-03-10).
- Pin workflow: set tenancy.model_override = "redwood-open-7B-v1.3@sha:a9f3d2" via control-plane API. This is reversible.
- Canary option: we can open a 5% split to v1.4 and enable per-request logging and difference hashes. We'll stream the logs to the Acme S3 bucket you provided for rapid triage.
- Diffs: preliminary run (attached patch) shows tokenization differences in 3% of prompts and factuality deltas in 0.8% of the evaluated set — enough to warrant triage for compliance-critical prompts.
- Timeline: If Acme approves pin now, I can apply it within 5 minutes and post the control-plane change id. If they want rollback across tenancy (not just pin), we should coordinate a 20-min maintenance window in the next 2 hours.

I'll wait for Marissa/Jamie's sign-off to execute.

—Dev
Lead Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
